title: Luxury minimalist product photography based on a reference image
prompt:
Using my uploaded reference image as the base, generate a minimalist, high-quality commercial still life photograph with the aesthetic of a luxury brand advertisement.

Preserve the general shape, proportions, and main color scheme of the core product in the reference so that it is instantly recognizable as the same product, but upgrade the overall texture and atmosphere of the image, making it look like an ad for a top-tier international fragrance, skincare item, or high-end electronic product.

No clutter, no elaborate scene setup—only keep very simple geometric supports (such as a plain white cube, a cylinder, or a thin transparent panel). The supports must be simple and low-profile, existing only to hold and accentuate the product.

Strongly emphasize the material details of the product, and let the lighting fully serve those materials:

Liquids should have clearly visible viscosity and volume. Avoid any cheap plastic feel, complex patterns, or gaudy stickers; the overall material quality must feel cool, restrained, and luxurious.

The contours should be crisp and layered, and the shadows should be soft and clean, with no noise or dirty shadow patches. You may use a near-macro viewpoint, moving in closer to the product to highlight materials and details, while preserving ample negative space around the frame so the product can "speak for itself" in the emptiness.

Keep the overall color scheme neutral and calm. The product’s own color can be slightly more saturated, making it the single visual focal point in the scene. Do not use exaggerated gradient backgrounds, flashy colored lighting, or e-commerce promo aesthetics. No large-price text, labels, or cartoon graphics.

The final result must be a high-resolution commercial key visual that looks ready for a magazine back cover or a high-end brand announcement poster: minimalist, quiet, high-end, with the core product confidently centered, surrounded by clean negative space and precisely controlled lighting.

title: Ultra-Realistic Candid Nighttime Smartphone Photo Prompt
prompt:
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph, 9:16 vertical.
Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for general facial proportions and vibe,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.
Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.
Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.
Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.
Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.
Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.
Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.
Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.
Negative Prompt
anime, illustration, painting, stylized,
studio lighting, beauty lighting, soft portrait,
sharp focus, clean face, perfect anatomy, smooth skin,
fashion editorial, posed portrait, cinematic grading, film still,
tripod shot, professional photography,
identity match, face copy, real person replication

•Jewelry: small earring visible (subtle, warm tone).

•Fine

title: Ultra-Wide Angle Dynamic Pose Remake Prompt
prompt:
Ultra-Wide Angle Perspective and Dynamic Pose Remake Edit
This is an edit of the original image, not the generation of a new character.
Please use the original image as a strict reference to determine:
 * The identity, hairstyle, and overall fashion style of the person,
 * The general type of background and location (same street, same room, same beach, same architectural style, etc.).
It is allowed to completely change the camera position, angle, and pose, but the scene must remain in the same location, and the same person and clothing design must be retained.
Camera and Perspective:
 * Use an ultra-wide-angle or fisheye lens feel (approx. 12–18mm full-frame look).
 * The camera angle must be significantly different from the original image: use dramatic angles, such as:
   * Low angle looking up from directly below (worm's eye view),
   * High angle looking down from directly above (bird's eye view),
   * Extremely low angle close to the ground,
   * High angle shot from above,
   * Tilted Dutch angles.
 * Always create a strong **foreshortening** effect: body parts close to the lens appear huge, while the rest of the body recedes in perspective.
 * The final result must look like a bold fashion or street photograph, completely realistic, not an illustration or anime.
Background Consistency:
 * Maintain the same location as the original image: the same street, bridge, room, studio, beach, and the same general structure and materials.
 * Do not replace the background with a completely different place.
 * Seeing different parts of the environment is allowed and expected due to the change in camera angle.
 * When new areas appear, logically extend the original environment (same architecture, fences, road signs, walls, colors, materials, lighting style), as if the camera moved within the same place.
Body Parts Close to the Lens (1–2 parts, sometimes 3):
 * In each edit, select one or two main body parts extremely close to the lens (sometimes even three in more complex poses).
 * Vary between different images; do not always use the same body parts.
 * Allowed body parts close to the lens include:
   * One or both hands/fingers reaching towards the camera,
   * One or both feet/shoes/boots close to the lens,
   * Knees or thighs,
   * Face very close to the lens,
   * Shoulders or chest close to the lens in a tilted pose.
 * The selected body parts should be extremely close to the lens, almost touching it, and exhibit visible skin texture, fabric texture, and realistic wide-angle distortion.
Pose and Overall Posture (Complex and Varied):
 * Create strong, cool, dynamic poses to match the extreme perspective.
 * Randomly use different types of poses, including:
   * Standing and extending one leg or one hand towards the camera,
   * Crouching or squatting low to the ground,
   * Sitting on the floor or an object,
   * Lying on the ground with legs or feet towards the lens,
   * Leaning aggressively towards the camera,
   * Twisting the body, crossing legs, or arching the back to form more dynamic lines.
 * Complex poses are allowed, such as:
   * Hands forming shapes near the lens (peace sign, triangle, frame, pointing at the viewer),
   * Both feet towards the lens,
   * One hand and one foot both enlarged in the foreground,
   * Face close to the lens while hands or feet are also visible in perspective.
 * Maintain credible anatomy even with extreme foreshortening.
Angle and Attitude (Randomization):
 * Randomize camera angle and direction (up, down, side, Dutch tilt) while keeping the composition visually balanced and powerful.
 * Maintain a cool, confident, and fashion/editorial or street style atmosphere, depending on the original outfit.
 * Facial expressions can vary (serious, playful, confident, mysterious) but must still look like the same person.
Lighting and Rendering:
 * Maintain a similar general time period and lighting atmosphere as the original (day vs. night, indoor vs. outdoor, soft light vs. hard light), but enhance contrast and color to make the image powerful and dramatic.
 * Maintain realistic shadows and contact points with the ground or floor.
 * High resolution, sharp details, with clear skin texture, fabric weave, and material highlights.
Variation and Randomness:
 * Each edit should look distinctly different from the original and other edits, with different:
   * Camera angles,
   * Pose types,
   * Body parts closest to the lens,
   * Orientation (straight, tilted, from above, from below).
 * Avoid repeating the exact same “single foot close-up” composition; generate a variety of dynamic poses and angles.
Strict Rules:
 * Do not turn the person into someone else.
 * Do not change the type of clothing; only restyle it through pose, perspective, and minor natural movement of the garment.
 * Do not move the scene to a completely different location; always stay within a logical extension of the original location.
 * Do not add text, logos, watermarks, or graphic design elements.
 * Do not switch to painting, illustration, or anime style; maintain realism.
Summary:
Transform the original photo into a dramatic, realistic, ultra-wide-angle photograph with extreme camera angles (including viewing from directly below or above), where one or more body parts are tight against the lens and appear huge, the rest of the body recedes in perspective, and the same person poses in a fashionable, complex, and powerful manner within a consistent, extended version of the original environment.

You are a top fashion street photographer and visual layout director. * **Overall Frame**: 3x3 nine-grid collage layout.
* **Separators**: Thin black borders separating each cell.

* **Visual Style**: Paparazzi style, Street Style, Candid shot feel.
* **Lighting Setting**: Strong outdoor natural sunlight, Hard shadows, high contrast, simulating midday sun.

To replicate the richness of the original image, please construct the screen content according to the following steps:

**Step 1: Determine Core Parameters**
* **Protagonist**: {argument name="target character" default="A young fit woman with a brown ponytail, wearing black sunglasses"}
* **Outfit**: {argument name="target clothing" default="Taupe tight yoga set, crop top and high-waisted leggings, holding a blue denim jacket"}
* **Scene**: {argument name="target environment" default="Sunny Los Angeles street parking lot, with blurred black SUV cars and chain-link fence in the background"}
* **Prop**: {argument name="handheld item" default="A beige insulated water bottle, a mobile phone"}

**Step 2: Shot Generation (Detailed description of 9 perspectives)**
You need to generate descriptions for 9 photos from different angles, arranged in a 3x3 order:
1.  **Top Left**: Full body walking forward, natural expression.
2.  **Top Center**: Head close-up, showing facial details, sunglasses, and hairstyle.
3.  **Top Right**: Low angle shot, with part of a car silhouette in the background, showing leg lines.
4.  **Middle Left**: Back view close-up, upper body, showing back lines and hairstyle details.
5.  **Center**: Top-down or high angle, capturing the moment of looking down at the road or phone.
6.  **Middle Right**: Side profile medium shot, capturing the dynamic blur of walking.
7.  **Bottom Left**: Moment of putting on/taking off a jacket, or a close-up of holding the jacket.
8.  **Bottom Center**: Side/rear view, showing body curves and hip lines.
9.  **Bottom Right**: Long shot back view, walking away, setting the environmental context.

**Step 3: Detail Filling**
* **Material**: Emphasize the fabric texture of the clothing (e.g., knit, denim), and the realistic texture of the skin (pores, sweat).
* **Background Processing**: The background needs depth of field blur (Bokeh) to highlight the person. Background elements include: vehicles, fences, and road surfaces in [Target Environment].

**Lighting**: Harsh daylight, direct sun, distinct shadows.
**Subject**: [Target Character] wearing [Target Clothing].

**Panels**:
- Panel 1: Full body walking towards camera.
- Panel 2: Close-up on face with sunglasses.
- Panel 3: Low angle shot next to a car.
- Panel 4: Back view close-up.
- Panel 5: High angle candid shot.
- Panel 6: Side profile walking.
- Panel 7: Interacting with jacket/prop.
- Panel 8: Side/Back angle walking.
- Panel 9: Full body back view walking away.
**Details**: Telephoto lens compression, depth of field, sharp focus on subject, grainy film texture optionally.

---

Please fill in the following parameters and generate the final drawing prompt:

* **[Target Character]**: (e.g., A young fit woman with a brown ponytail, wearing black sunglasses, style X)

* **[Handheld Item]**: (e.g., A beige insulated water bottle, a mobile phone)

title: iPhone Aesthetic Prompt Generator Framework
prompt:
<role>
You're specialized in computational photography, specifically the optical characteristics of the iPhone 16/17 Pro Max sensor system. You translate human concepts into mathematically precise image generation prompts.
</role>

<cognitive_framework>
<principle name="Context Hunger">
If the user provides a vague concept (e.g., "girl at a cafe"), you must explicitly invent the missing environmental, lighting, and styling details to ensure a complete image.
</principle>
<principle name="The iPhone Aesthetic">
All outputs must strictly simulate high-end mobile photography.
- Focal Lengths: 24mm (Main), 13mm (Ultra Wide), or 77mm (Telephoto).
- Characteristics: "Apple ProRAW" color science, sharp details (Deep Fusion), computational bokeh (Portrait Mode), and Smart HDR dynamic range.
- Avoid: Anamorphic lens flares, exaggerated "cinema" bokeh, or vintage film grain (unless specified as a filter).
</principle>
<principle name="Imperfection is Realism">
To achieve "ultra-realism," you must inject terms describing unpolished reality: digital noise (not film grain), skin texture, slightly blown-out highlights (common in mobile), and natural "snapshot" framing.
</principle>
<principle name="JSON Precision">
Your output is a strict JSON object designed for programmatic use.
</principle>
</cognitive_framework>

<visual_analysis_reference>
The "Influencer Aesthetic" is defined by:
- Vibe: "Plandid" (planned candid), effortlessness, aspirational lifestyle.
- Lighting: Natural window light, golden hour, or "flash photography" (hard flash) for night shots.
- Framing: Vertical (9:16) native mobile aspect ratio, often selfies or point-of-view (POV).
</visual_analysis_reference>

<instructions>
1. Analyze the user's request for subject and mood.
2. Enrich the request using "iPhone Photography" constraints.
3. Format the output strictly as a JSON object with the following schema.
</instructions>

<json_schema>
{

    "style": "iPhone Pro Max Photography",

  },
  "prompt_components": {

    "lighting": "Smart HDR lighting, natural source, or direct flash",

    "imperfections": "Digital noise, motion blur, authentic skin texture, screen reflection (if mirror)"
  },
  "full_prompt_string": "The combined, comma-separated string optimized for realistic mobile generation",
  "negative_prompt": "Standard negatives + 'professional camera, DSLR, bokeh balls, anamorphic, cinema lighting, studio lighting'"
}
</json_schema>

<task>
Await user description of the scene. Generate the JSON output immediately.
</task>

Ingredients and steps flow dynamically around the main dish;
Clear hierarchy: Main dish > Steps > Ingredients > Optional data;

Soft, natural studio lighting, minimalist texture or gradient background, creating a high-end editorial look.

1080×1080, ultra-sharp, suitable for social media display, no watermark.

title: Vertical Layered Diorama Concept Art Prompt for Sci-Fi Film
prompt:
You are an **architect and concept artist who visualizes story structures**.
Analyze the provided input text (the movie synopsis) and generate a **"Vertical Layered Diorama"** where the height direction represents the timeline.

The character in the attached reference image should be placed in the "Present (Middle Layer)" or "Future (Top Layer)" of this vertical structure, acting as the **storyteller/time traveler**, and posed to **look down on the past / look up at the future**.

---

## ▼ Instructions for Generation Process (Nano Banana Pro: Thinking Mode)

1. **[Step 1: Timeline Mapping]**: Decompose the synopsis into three time phases and assign them to physical layers.

   * **Bottom Layer (Past/Origin)**: Cause of gravity collapse, sealing, deep underground. Dark and heavy tone.
   * **Middle Layer (Present/Conflict)**: Survival and conflict in gravity-broken Tokyo. Vivid and dynamic tone.
   * **Top Layer (Future/Conclusion)**: Birth of a new gravity order, hope or ruin. Open and symbolic tone.
2. **[Step 2: Connection Design]**: Design the layers so they are not disconnected, but physically connected by elements such as **Gravity Well pillars / inverted spiral staircases / magnetic elevators / waterfalls where falling turns into rising**.
3. **[Step 3: Text Integration]**: Place the movie title in a stable location at the very top or bottom, and engrave famous lines on the **layer boundaries**.

---

## ▼ Design and Style Specification

* **Composition/Layout**: **Vertical Cross-section / Tower structure**. Aspect ratio is vertical (**9:16**). Viewpoint is **slightly above the front**, at an angle that shows the thickness and depth of the layers.
* **Taste**: **Precise museum model, geological cross-section, surreal architecture**. Express different eras and materials in each layer (concrete → neon metal → white structure on clouds) while integrating them as one giant object.
* **Texture/Image Quality**: Photorealistic, precise detail, **8k**. Raindrops, wet asphalt, reflections, fog, volumetric light.
* **Gravity Expression (Important)**:

  * Tokyo roads **curve 90 degrees as a continuous surface**, where the ground becomes a wall, and then arches to the ceiling, connecting in a **loop**.
  * Buildings, signs, cars, and pipes **protrude vertically** from the curved surface, and landmarks exist **upside down** suspended in the air.
  * Depict as a **physically continuous urban structure**, not just a reflection.
  * Light sources match the reality of a rainy night (reflections of neon and streetlights, diffused light through clouds).

---

## ▼ Input Text (Fictional Movie)

**Title**: **{argument name="Movie Title" default="GRAVITY BROKEN TOKYO (Gravity Fault City Tokyo)"}**
**Genre**: Sci-Fi Thriller / Disaster / Human Drama

**Synopsis**:
One night, due to the fracture of the "Gravity Lattice" above Tokyo, the city's gravity lost its uniformity. Roads bend into the sky, buildings lose their up and down, and falling chooses a direction. People survive by redefining "where the ground is." The narrator (reference character) dives across time to the origin of the gravity collapse, struggles in the current city, and reaches the new order of the future.

### [Bottom Layer / Past and Origin] (PHASE 1: YEAR 2036)

* **Setting**: Deep underground research complex. Black basalt-like strata, old wiring, gravity control reactor "Atlas Core."
* **Description**: Suggests that the device meant to "fix" gravity instead triggered the "tearing" of gravity. Tools and paper documents are scattered on the floor, and water droplets float horizontally due to gravity disturbances.
* **Tone**: Dark, oppressive. Warning lights, fine dust, the stillness of low gravity.

### [Middle Layer / Present and Conflict] (PHASE 2: YEAR 2046)

* **Setting**: The center of gravity-broken Tokyo, where rain continues to fall. A continuous city where **wet asphalt curves 90 degrees, becoming a wall, and continuing to the ceiling**.
* **Description (Reflecting Gravity Prompt)**:

  * Roads rise vertically and then arch overhead to loop.
  * Landmarks are suspended upside down, and road signs protrude into the air.
  * Neon lights bleed along the curved surfaces in the fog and light rain, and reflections establish the light of a real rainy night.
* **Character Placement**: Place the reference character in the **"Present" of the Middle Layer**. Grasping a railing or pipe with one hand, pointing to the light of the upper layer with the other. Gaze **looking down on the past (bottom layer) while looking up at the future (top layer)**.
* **Tone**: Dynamic, tense. People's evacuation routes continue along the "wall roads."

### [Top Layer / Future and Conclusion] (PHASE 3: YEAR 2058)

* **Setting**: The "Stable Gravity Layer" above the clouds. City remnants are rearranged, forming a new residential area composed of white frame structures and transparent materials.
* **Description**: Ambiguous whether the gravity lattice was "repaired" or if a "new direction" was accepted. A pale column of light from the gravity well extends into the sky, connecting to the darkness below.
* **Tone**: Open and symbolic. Hope and unease coexist.

---

## ▼ Connection Points (Gimmicks connecting the layers: Required)

* **Gravity Well Light Column**: A column of pale blue volumetric light penetrating from the core of the bottom layer to the top layer. Particles flow upward.
* **Inverted Spiral Staircase**: "Up" and "down" switch midway. Small year plates on the staircase railing.
* **Waterfall where Falling Turns into Rising**: The water flow reverses at the boundary, emphasizing the layer separation.

---

## ▼ Visual Elements (Motifs to emphasize)

* Wet asphalt, trajectory of raindrops, neon reflections, fog, volumetric light.
* Curved City: Roads, architecture, and signs bend as a **continuous surface**, forming a **physical loop**.
* Small objects floating in the air (umbrellas, paper scraps, tools, petals) visualize the disturbance in the direction of gravity.
* Material changes in each layer: Rough rock stratum underground → Wet concrete and metal in the present → White structure and transparent material in the future.

---

## ▼ Text Instructions (On-screen Typography)

* **Title**: "**{argument name="Title" default="GRAVITY BROKEN TOKYO"}**"

* **Timeline Display (Optional)**: Small next to each layer

title: System Prompt for High-Control Photorealistic Image Generation
prompt:
name: "Reality-First Prompt
    primary_use: "Image generation prompt creation (photoreal, editorial-documentary, product, architecture, nature, illustration/3D if requested)"
    works_for: ["people", "objects", "animals", "food", "interiors", "architecture", "landscapes", "abstract concepts (by grounding into visible cues)"]
  mission: >
    Write high-control prompts that reliably produce believable, real-world results by anchoring hard constraints,
    describing observable details, defining one priority focus, and adding strict negatives to prevent common artifacts.
  why_it_works:
    - "Front-loads non-negotiables (aspect ratio, medium, shot type, location/time, framing)."
    - "Uses domain language (camera/light/material behavior) instead of vague aesthetics."
    - "Defines realism with observable cues (micro-texture, imperfections, separation)."
    - "Adds disambiguation clauses to prevent frequent model failure modes."
    - "Strong strict negatives target the 'AI look' and unwanted styles."
    - "Avoids contradictions; keeps one coherent lighting/color pipeline."
  operating_principles:
    - "Hard constraints first; never bury them."
    - "Write like a photographer/designer: measurable, stageable, physically plausible."
    - "Pick ONE primary focus and define it using 3–8 observable features."
    - "Convert style words into camera/light/material behaviors (not filters)."
    - "Specify color & light explicitly: white balance, warmth, contrast, exposure, saturation rules."
    - "Specify camera behavior: lens/phone realism, DoF/focus falloff, grain, edge softness, motion blur."
    - "Use strict negatives as guardrails; keep them targeted and non-contradictory."
    - "No contradictory instructions (e.g., 'accurate WB' + 'heavy teal-orange grade')."
  required_inputs:
    - key: "subject"
      description: "What to depict (who/what), specific nouns."
      examples: ["{argument name="subject example 1" default="a ceramic mug with visible glaze crazing"}", "a mountain bike leaning against a wall"]
    - key: "medium"
      description: "Photo / smartphone photo / film photo / 3D render / illustration (must be explicit)."
      examples: ["ultra-realistic smartphone photo", "35mm film photo", "studio product photo"]
    - key: "aspect_ratio"
      description: "Orientation and ratio."
      examples: ["9:16 vertical", "1:1 square", "3:2 horizontal"]
    - key: "setting"
      description: "Where + time-of-day + primary light source."
      examples: ["indoors near a window during daytime", "overcast outdoor street, late afternoon"]
    - key: "shot"
      description: "Framing + angle + distance + occlusions if any."
      examples: ["close-up from collarbone to top of head", "top-down tabletop shot, 50cm distance"]
    - key: "primary_focus"
      description: "ONE priority: what must look correct/real."
      examples: ["skin realism", "material realism", "typography accuracy", "motion re"

title: Cinematic Gourmet Burger Explosion Prompt (Code Style)
prompt:
import physics_engine as cinematic
from studio_lighting import RimLight, SpotLight

class GourmetBurger:
    def __init__(self):
        self.state = "assembled"
        self.ingredients = [
            "toasted_brioche_bun", 
            "wagyu_patty", 
            "molten_cheddar", 
            "crispy_lettuce", 
            "heirloom_tomato",
            "secret_sauce_droplets"
        ]

    def trigger_explosion(self):
        """
        Executes the slow-motion deconstruction effect.
        """
        self.state = "mid-air_burst"
        
        for item in self.ingredients:
            # Applying physics for the "flying" effect
            item.apply_force(direction="outward", velocity="slow_motion")
            item.render_texture(quality="hyper_detailed")
            
        # Suspends liquid particles in 3D space
        cinematic.suspend_fluids(type="sauce", density="high_viscosity")

# Environment Configuration
scene = cinematic.Scene(background="dark_studio_charcoal")
scene.add_lighting([
    RimLight(intensity=0.8, color="warm_gold"),
    SpotLight(target="patty_texture", focus="ultra_sharp")
])

# Execute the render
burger = GourmetBurger()
burger.trigger_explosion()

render_output = scene.capture(style="cinematic_advertising", realistic=True)

title: Triptych Composition Prompt for Abstract Fashion Editorial
prompt:
THE TASK
Act as a world-class fashion photographer shooting a defining editorial campaign. Create a cohesive 3-panel vertical triptych (stacked top, middle, bottom) of the same subject. The sequence escalates intimacy and intensity through extreme proximity, revealing tactile hyper-realism and restrained dynamic power purely via photographic technique — no environmental changes, no added elements.
TRIPTYCH COMPOSITION
(VERTICAL STACK – ESCALATING CLOSE-UP INTENSITY)
Top Panel – Presence (Intense Dominant Close-Up)
Dynamic low 3/4 angle close-up (camera below the main form, tilted upward) to create looming, commanding scale.
Tight crop: the subject’s primary focal feature and sharp contours dominate; one side falls into deep shadow.
Subtle implied motion via slight rotational tilt and micro-blur only on far-edge highlights — keep the central zone razor-sharp.
Specular streaks rake across glossy surfaces like wet lacquer, emphasizing curvature and fine material imperfections.
Background: pure high-key white with faint gradient falloff — identical across all panels, no environmental cues.
Middle Panel – Control (Kinetic Structural Sweep)
Canted-angle macro from the side with aggressive perspective distortion.
Crop frames the central structural zone, with key elements off-center and partially cut by frame edges.
Highlights slice diagonally across contoured channels and ridges due to the dramatic angle.
Very shallow depth of field: nearest surface tack-sharp, farther planes melt softly to suggest velocity and tension.
Same pure high-key white background and exact tonal range — variation achieved solely through camera angle and lens proximity.
Bottom Panel – Essence (Extreme Graphic Detail)
Extreme macro from an aggressive angle evoking a controlled whip-pan. Choose one signature detail and make it feel alive with implied motion while remaining graphically pristine:

A protruding or extending element shot from below, strongly foreshortened, reaching toward the lens,
Or a central geometric/functional feature shot on a steep diagonal, highlights spiraling like motion trails,
Or a sharp edge or blade-like contour shot from behind, catching a razor-thin specular line.

Apply controlled directional blur only to a secondary trailing plane; keep the primary micro-texture impeccably crisp.
Frame so tight it becomes near-abstract: beveled edges, micro-scratches, gloss pooling, subtle material stress marks, fine imperfections.
No debris, no additional elements — identical high-key white background maintained.
STYLING & BOLD CHOICES (CRITICAL)
Subject: {argument name="subject material" default="any high-gloss, sculpted form with precise contours and reflective surfaces"}.
No additional objects, characters, props, text, or logos.
All sense of energy and motion derived exclusively from camera technique: low/canted angles, foreshortening, shallow depth of field, controlled selective blur, and highlight flow.
Identical lighting rig across all three panels — consistent

The prompt dictates escalating intimacy and intensity through extreme close-up camera techniques (low angle, macro, canted angle, selective blur) to create a dynamic, abstract fashion editorial look without relying on environment or props.

prompt:
[Core Task Instruction]
You are an AI expert with real-time web search capabilities and top-tier data visualization design skills. Please perform the following two steps:
Research Phase: Immediately conduct comprehensive online research on the user-specified [{argument name="research target field" default="2025 Chinese New Energy Vehicles"}]. Visualization Phase: Based on your research results, design a professional Infographic. You need to accurately classify and fill the specific projects researched into the five visual level modules defined below, ranging from “Hāng” to “Lā” (Good to Bad).

[User Specified Target Field/Product]
[{argument name="target field" default="Fill in the content you need to research here, e.g., Popular smartphones in 2024, Sugar-free tea beverage brands on the market, Marvel movies of the last decade, Code editors commonly used by programmers"}]

[Image Design Requirements]
Overall Style:
A modular infographic with clear structure and a strong modern feel, using a “Bento Grid” layout. The background should be clean and simple, focusing on content presentation. Visually, it must show a strong hierarchical drop-off from high to low.

Level Structure and Visual Definition (Strictly enforce the following five levels):

Level 1 (Highest Level): 夯 (Hāng - Top Tier)
Research Filling Standard: According to research, the generally recognized “Version King” in the field, with dominant popularity and undisputed top-tier products/works.

Visual Representation: Occupies the topmost or largest module on the screen. The color scheme is explosive burst red and glorious gold, with visual effects like halos or energy overflow. The font is the largest and boldest. The module must display the names or high-quality images of the representative products researched, accompanied by minimalist phrases of praise (e.g., “Blown up across the internet,” “Masterpiece”).

Level 2: Top Tier

Research Filling Standard: Hardcore powerhouses, whose reputation may not be as high as “Hāng,” but are highly praised and are the preferred high-quality projects for experts.

Visual Representation: Located on the second layer. The color scheme is solid, high-end burning orange and metallic silver. The module design appears robust and textured. Display representative powerhouse products.

Level 3: Superior

Research Filling Standard: Superior choices, tasteful, solid middle ground that is definitely worth buying/watching, representing a certain level of connoisseurship.

Visual Representation: Located in the middle layer. The color scheme is bright, clean lemon yellow and cool gray. The design style is modern and refreshing. Display representative high-quality middle-class products.

Level 4: NPC

Research Filling Standard: Generic products with no memory points, mass-produced industrial products, neither good nor bad, easily forgotten. Must include specific product or brand names, do not be vague.

Visual Representation: Located in the lower-middle layer. The color scheme is dull and bland bread color/beige or cardboard brown. The module design appears ordinary, repetitive, and lacks personality. Display those very mediocre products.

Level 5 (Bottom Level): 拉完了 (Lā - Failed)

Research Filling Standard: Recognized “landmines,” “IQ taxes,” disastrous failed products found in the research, or even products that are worse than nothing. Must include specific product or brand names, do not be vague.

Visual Representation: Squeezed into the bottom or corner of the screen, with compressed visual space. The color scheme is desperate black, pale white, and features obvious digital glitch, fragmentation, or decay visual effects. Display those famous “flop” products, accompanied by warning phrases (e.g., “Run away,” “Big sucker”).

Create a hand-drawn doodle with uneven, rough, and exaggerated line art. The lines should be loose, wobbly, and erratic, like a child’s excited scribble. Outlines should be thick, broken, and inconsistent. The drawing style must look rushed, spontaneous, and energetic. Use visible pencil or crayon strokes that add to the untidy, chaotic feel.

Use bright, pastel, and vivid colors in a flat, playful way. The color should be filled in without careful detail, mimicking a rough, sketchbook feel. No photorealism, no photo texture, no cinematic lighting, no digital painting. The illustration should look like a true, chaotic, scribbly doodle. Avoid sharp or clean edges, avoid detailed realism. The lines and colors must be rough and spontaneous.

Monumental. Immovable. The viewer feels physically below the character. Power through perspective alone.

title: Cinematic Christmas Transformation with Composition Lock
prompt:
### ROLE & OBJECTIVE
You are an AI expert in visual analysis and creative scene composition. Your task is to precisely analyze a user-uploaded image and then transform it into a detailed, atmospheric Christmas scene while maintaining the original composition, poses, and spatial layout.

### INPUT
[PLEASE UPLOAD YOUR IMAGE HERE]

### PROCESS STEPS

**STEP 1: Visual Deconstruction (Analysis)**
Examine the uploaded image and create a detailed inventory of the following elements:
1. **Subjects & People:** Who is in the image? Describe their exact poses, facial expressions, and the interactions between them.
2. **Scene & Environment:** Where does the scene take place (e.g., living room, office, park)? Describe the architecture, the background elements, and the original lighting conditions.
3. **Key Objects:** List all prominent items currently visible in the image (furniture, technology, decorations, etc.).

**STEP 2: The Christmas Metamorphosis (Transformation)**
Based on the analysis from Step 1, rewrite the scene description as if it were a high-production shot from a cinematic Christmas movie. Apply the following rules:
* **Atmosphere & Lighting:** Shift the lighting to a warm, golden glow (e.g., emanating from fairy lights, candles, or a fireplace). The mood must be cozy, festive, and magical.
* **Attire:** Replace the original clothing of all subjects with appropriate, festive winter wear (e.g., Norwegian wool sweaters, Santa hats, elegant holiday attire), ensuring the original poses remain identical.
* **Object Transformation & Enhancement:**
* Transform existing objects into Christmas equivalents where logical (e.g., a standard houseplant becomes a small decorated tree).
* Integrate essential Christmas elements: A decorated tree, garlands, wrapped gifts, advent wreaths, and subtle frost or snow if outdoors.

### DESIRED OUTPUT (Final Image Prompt)
Based on Step 2, generate a single, extremely detailed, and vivid visual description. This description should serve as a master prompt for an image generator to create the final Christmas photo. Focus on textures, specific visual details, and the festive "Hygge" atmosphere while emphasizing that the core composition of the original photo must remain unchanged.

6.  **[VAR_COLOR]:** If up, use "Warm Sunny Lighting (Green/Gold accents)"; if down, use "Cool Overcast Lighting (Red/Grey accents)".

**"An exquisite 3D Isometric Miniature Diorama, solid color background.**

**1. Visual Anchor:**
The main subject of the scene is a miniature version of **[VAR_PRODUCT]**, with the company's 3D Logo on top of the structure.

**3. Environmental Atmosphere (Data Atmosphere):**

* *(If down)*: The scene is slightly desolate, with yellowing or falling leaves, and small puddles on the ground.

**4. Floating Information Layer (UI Overlay):**

* Main Label: '{{User_Stock}} **[VAR_PRICE]**'
* Sub Label: '**[VAR_CHANGE]**' (with arrow)

**"**

---

## STEP 3: EXECUTE GENERATION (Execute Image Generation)
Use the specific description that has been **replaced** in STEP 2 to generate the image immediately.

---

title: Precure Transformation Design System Prompt
prompt:
# Your Role
You are the chief designer for a girls' anime.
Your mission is to design a character suitable for a girls' anime according to my requests.

# Your Request
Please design the transformed appearance of the character I present as a Precure.
**The design must look natural if it appeared in the Precure series.**

# Design Procedure
Please proceed with the design according to the following flow:

## Motif Determination
Devise a motif that matches the image of the character I presented.
**Capture the character's characteristics and select an appropriate motif.**
**Do not consider elements such as the background of the input image; focus only on the character's characteristics.**
Select the motif from a variety of candidates. For example:
- Nature (sky, earth, sea, etc.)
- Animals (dogs, cats, rabbits, etc.)
- Plants (various flowers, etc.)
- Food (fruits, etc.)
- Emotions (love, joy, etc.)
- Conceptual things (peace, nobility, etc.)

## Direction Determination
Determine the design direction for the character.
**Capture the character's characteristics and find a direction that suits the character.**
For example:
- Cute
- Beautiful
- Brave
- Comical

## Image Color Determination
Determine the character's image color.
**Select a color appropriate for the character's image and the determined motif.**
Colors should be bright and vivid, such as red, blue, yellow, green, purple, and avoid dark colors like brown or gray.
However, black and white can be used if they suit the character's image.

## Name Determination
Determine the character's Precure name.
The name must be Cure ○○ (preferably 3 to 6 characters excluding "Cure").
The ○○ part should be a name that evokes the character's motif.
(For example, if the motif is a star, use Star, Étoile, Stella, etc.)
Basically, use foreign language words.
Soft-sounding English, French, or Italian words are desirable, and caution is needed when using strong-sounding German or Russian words.
**The name must not overlap with existing Precure names.**

## Character Design Determination
**The design must be suitable as a Precure.**

### Hair
The hair color should be bright and vivid, in the same color family as the original character's hair color.
For example, changes like:
- Red → Pink
- Black → Blue or Green
- Brown → Blonde
The hairstyle is generally an exaggerated, voluminous version of the original character's hairstyle.
However, it is also possible to add elements that the original character does not have (e.g., large twin tails for a short-haired character).

### Outfit
The design is based on the image of the motif. However, avoid designs that are exactly the motif; the design should only suggest the motif.
The color is based on the character's image color.
The character's direction should also be reflected.
For example:
- For a cute direction, use cute designs adorned with frills, etc.
- For a beautiful direction, use streamlined and elegant designs.
- For a brave direction, use sharp and active designs.
- For a comical direction, use pop and cheerful designs.

### Eyes
The eyes should be designed as in the following examples:
- Make the color brighter and more vivid than the original character's.
- Add stars or hearts inside the eyes.

### Accessories
Add accessories such as earrings and tiaras.

### Items
**Since Precure fundamentally fights unarmed, handheld weapons are strictly prohibited.**
They should generally not be holding anything.

## Final Pose
**The pose must be a visually striking pose suitable for a transforming heroine's finishing pose.**
Consider the character's direction (cute, brave, etc.) for the pose design and facial expression during the pose.

## Catchphrase
Devise the character's catchphrase.
The catchphrase should be related to the motif.
Examples:
- Motif is Flower: "A single flower blooming on the earth"
- Motif is Star: "A sparkling star shining in the universe"
- Motif is Sky: "The infinitely spreading blue sky"
**Do not use the examples as is.**

# Final Output
Finish the design determined so far into a single illustration.

title: Korean Girl Group Style Photo Shoot Prompt
prompt:
I. Composition
1 Layout: Overall 3:4 ratio, four-panel collage, 3:4 small images arranged in 2x2
2 Framing: Close-up to extreme close-up, subject occupies a large proportion of the screen
3 Angle: Eye-level close-up, slight left/right variation, uniform clean background

II. Main Subject
1 Reference Source: Use uploaded reference image as the strict identity source
2 Consistency Requirement: Zero deviation
3 Face: Delicate face shape, slightly large eyes, a small mole below the right eye, long and thin nose bridge
4 Skin Quality: Fair with light pink undertones, delicate skin, slight soft focus
5 Details: Prominent highlights on the nose bridge and mid-face, slight redness on cheeks and nose tip, scattered light freckles

III. Makeup Details
1 Base Makeup: Transparent and clean, light matte finish with slight sheen
2 Blush: Pink concentrated on the cheeks and sides of the nose bridge
3 Eye Makeup: Naturally enlarged, long lashes, clear eyes
4 Lip Makeup: Hydrated, plump lips, gradient from light pink to peach, soft cupid's bow

IV. Hairstyle and Accessories
1 Hairstyle: Black long straight hair, center part, full volume, naturally draped
2 Flyaways: Small amount of hair naturally floating around the forehead
3 Hair Accessories: One pink hair clip on each side, bright pink and light pink colors, metal clip visible

V. Hands and Accessories
1 Nails: Extra-long shape, translucent or light colors, with fine glitter and 3D decorations
2 Rings: Multiple pink cute-shaped rings, candy and floral aesthetics, exaggerated but soft and cute volume
3 Hand Gesture Style: Near the face and lips, highlighting nail and ring details

VI. Clothing and Material
1 Top: Fuzzy textured jacket or sleeves, white fluffy and soft
2 Inner Wear: Light pink camisole or top, off-shoulder or one-shoulder effect
3 Overall Style: Sweet and soft, with a touch of cool edge

VII. Four Panel Actions and Expressions
1 Top Left: Hands cupping face close to the camera, expression is cold and slightly wronged, looking directly at the camera
2 Top Right: Finger near the lips or lightly touching the lip edge, eyes calm and slightly teasing, closer extreme close-up
3 Bottom Left: Chin or arm resting on the edge of a table, eyes looking sideways, expression is dazed and vacant
4 Bottom Right: Hand clenched lightly against the chin, smiling but restrained, looking directly at the camera, more approachable demeanor

VIII. Lighting and Tone
1 Lighting: High-key soft light, very shallow shadows, uniform overall
2 Color Tone: Predominantly cool white background, pink accents highlighted, skin tone leans cool pink
3 Contrast: Low contrast, clean and transparent, not heavy

IX. Texture and Visual Effect
1 Clarity: Features and hair strands are clear, skin details preserved but with slight blurring/softening
2 Depth of Field: Background blur is very weak or almost textureless, subject is more prominent
3 Atmosphere: Sweet Korean girl group magazine photo style, sweet and cute, delicate and dreamy, slight glass-like sheen.

title: 3D paper cut light box illustration framework
prompt:
Generate an art photograph of a highly dreamy and three-dimensional 3D paper cut light box.  
The paper cut theme is: {argument name="theme" default="a deer in a forest under the moonlight"}.

Layering structure and composition:
Design the image as a real, physical paper cut light box composed of 5–7 layers of paper stacked together. Each layer must have its own depth of field and clear silhouette, and you should be able to see the thickness of the paper and the shadows between layers.

Core structure:
- The image should clearly present a multi-layered silhouette effect, with visible physical spacing between the paper layers.
- Overall composition is vertical 3:4, with the light box centered, leaving a bit of space at the edges, like a glowing art object placed on a table.

Depth layout:
- Foreground (layers 1–2): use dark, intricate silhouettes that form a frame around the edges of the image, with elements matching the current theme, such as branches and vines for forest themes, windows and arches for city or castle themes, or rocks and coral for underwater or fantasy themes.
- Midground (layers 3–4): this holds the core subject of the theme, slightly central in the composition and taking up the main visual weight. The subject’s silhouette must be complete and not overly blocked by the foreground.
- Background (layers 5–6): use more simplified, lower-contrast silhouettes to show distant environment and structures, adding depth to the scene.

Three-dimensionality:
- There must be obvious physical spacing and shadows between layers. Light should pass between the paper layers to create soft gradations of light and dark, emphasizing the paper thickness and 3D depth, so it looks like a real paper cut light box, not a flat illustration.

Light and atmosphere (backlighting):
Backlighting:
- The light source must come from the very back of the scene, shining forward through all the paper layers.
- Light passing through the cutouts in each layer should form soft volumetric light and gradually decreasing brightness and contrast from back to front.

Color gradients (auto-adapting to the theme):
If no specific color scheme is given, automatically choose a main palette and gradient that fit the theme, while keeping a soft, night-light-friendly look. For example, warm gold to cool blue-green for forest themes, teal to deep blue for underwater themes, icy blue to deep blue for winter scenes, amber to electric blue for cyber cities, candlelight gold to deep indigo for castles, or deep blue to purple with golden glows for space themes.
If the user clearly specifies a color direction or mood (such as “cool sci-fi” or “pink-blue dreamy”), follow that as the top priority while maintaining the soft backlit, soothing feeling of a night light.

Overall feel:
The image should feel quiet, healing, and storybook-like, like a softly glowing bedtime story lamp, not a noisy neon poster or infographic.

Materials and details:
Paper texture:
- Emphasize the reality of heavy art paper: fine texture, slight visible fibers, clean sharp cut edges with visible thickness, and light that diffuses softly through the paper like a real fibrous material, not plastic or metal.

Physical light box photography feel:
- Present the image as a photograph of a real light box, not a flat illustration or vector graphic. You can faintly show the light box frame (simple white or light wood) and a slightly blurred tabletop or environment.
- The lighting should feel natural, with real-lens depth of field: slightly blurred foreground, sharp midground subject, and soft background.

Detail decorations:
- You may add a modest amount of tiny floating elements between paper layers to enhance space, such as tiny glowing dots, dust motes, snowflakes, bubbles, or other small particles relevant to the theme. Their number must be restrained so they only enhance atmosphere and depth without cluttering or disrupting the silhouette structure.

Technical parameters: vertical 3:4 ratio, high-resolution output.

prompt:

[NES Final Specification/Complete Version: BG-Only Algorithm Execution Type Dot Art Conversion Prompt]

Convert this image into BG dot art specifications for the Family Computer (NES) hardware, strictly executing the following mathematical and logical steps, without limiting the subject matter.

The purpose of this prompt is to satisfy the constraints required for BG to function on actual NES hardware. Aesthetic-only NES-style expression is prohibited.
Use only the BG layer; sprites are strictly prohibited.

────────────────────────
[Prerequisites (NES BG Implementation Rules)]
────────────────────────
- Output Resolution: 256 × 240 pixels
- Layer Used: NES BG only
- Sprite usage prohibited
- Transparency processing is not performed
- Index 0 of each palette is treated as the NES universal background color
- Index 0 is common to all palettes
- The color with the largest coverage area on the entire screen is assigned as the universal background color
- Color number 0 can also be used as a normal drawing color

────────────────────────
[Step 1: Geometric Image Processing (Protagonist Priority, No Deformation Cropping)]
────────────────────────
1. Set the conversion size to 256 × 240 pixels
2. Always maintain the aspect ratio of the original image
- Scale up or down until the shorter side fits the conversion size
- Stretching the image is strictly prohibited
3. Automatically detect the protagonist (person, animal, building, etc.) in the image, and adjust the crop position so that the protagonist is maximally contained within the frame
4. If the protagonist cannot be detected, crop based on the center of the screen

────────────────────────
[Step 2: Tile Decomposition and Attribute Block Definition (NES Compliant)]
────────────────────────
1. Divide the image into 8×8 pixel tiles
2. Treat 2×2 tiles (16×16 pixels) as 1 attribute block
3. Subsequent palette constraints and color constraints must be applied per attribute block

────────────────────────
[Step 3: Attribute Block Unit Palette Clustering (Maximum 4)]
────────────────────────
1. Analyze the color distribution within each 16×16 attribute block
2. Cluster all attribute blocks by color distribution similarity, classifying them into a maximum of 4 groups
3. If the hue (blue, green, etc.) is clearly different from other areas, treat it as an independent group whenever possible
4. However, the NES BG sub-palettes are limited to a maximum of 4. Prioritize the protagonist area, and areas of low importance may be integrated into similar colors

────────────────────────
[Step 4: NES BG Palette Generation (4 colors × 4 sets)]
────────────────────────
1. Index 0 (Universal Background Color)
- Calculate the color with the largest coverage area on the entire screen, and assign it to Index 0, common to all palettes
2. Index 1–3 (Unique Colors)
- For each sub-palette, select 3 colors that represent the 'light part,' 'mid-tone,' and 'dark part' of that attribute group
- Colors extremely close in hue or brightness to Index 0 are prohibited

────────────────────────

title: Precise Pose and Composition Replication Prompt
prompt:
I. Core Goals and Strong Constraints
1. Precise Pose Replication: Use Image 2 as the sole reference for the pose, and perform a “point-by-point alignment” replication of the full-body pose of the person in Image 1 (ensuring consistency in the orientation and curvature of the head, neck, shoulders, chest, hips, knees, ankles, arms, wrists, and fingers).
2. Consistent Perspective and Lens: The camera position, shooting angle, lens height, pitch angle, yaw angle, perspective relationship, and depth-of-field effect must be consistent with Image 2.
3. Consistent Composition: The position, proportion, negative space ratio, and cropping method (whether feet/head/hands are cropped) of the person in the frame must be consistent with Image 2.
4. Consistent Head and Gaze: The head tilt angle, chin lift/tuck degree, and gaze direction must be consistent with Image 2.
5. Appearance Prohibition: Strictly retain the identity features and style of the person in Image 1 (facial features, hairstyle, hair color, skin tone, clothing style and color, material, accessories, texture, body proportion, age temperament, art style/rendering style). Only change the pose and lens composition to match Image 2.

II. Execution Method and Calibration Requirements
1. Alignment Method: Use the skeleton of the person in Image 2 as the “target skeleton,” and “redirect” the skeleton of the person in Image 1 to the target skeleton; the limb angles, center of gravity position, and torso twist magnitude must match.
2. Key Point Priority: First match the center of gravity and pelvic orientation, then match the torso rotation and shoulder line, then match the extremities (hands, feet), and finally fine-tune finger and expression details.
3. Allowable Range of Variation: The error in pose and lens should be as close to zero as possible; if unavoidable, the error must be extremely small and not visually obvious.
4. Prohibitions: Do not add or delete objects; do not change clothing styling or details; do not change the character's style; do not change the background style leading to compositional changes; do not transfer the appearance features of the person in Image 2 to the person in Image 1.
description: A highly technical Chinese prompt designed for image-to-image generation (Nano Banana Pro) that strictly enforces the replication of a reference image's pose, camera angle, composition, and framing onto a subject from a different source image, while forbidding any change to the subject's identity or style.

title: Comprehensive manga one-page scene creation system prompt
prompt:
Act as a “comprehensive creative” who simultaneously holds the following three perspectives:
Author’s perspective
　→ Naturally capture nuances of the character’s emotions, atmosphere, and movement
Editor’s perspective
　→ Manage composition, natural flow of text, and consistency of information density
Reader’s perspective
　→ Prioritize the kind of emotion that instantly draws the viewer in and maximizes appeal
Make sure these three perspectives are fused without contradiction in your output.
■ Objective
Infer from the given images and settings to create “a still image that works as a one-page scene of Japanese manga/anime,” together with natural Japanese speech bubbles and monologues.
Make “micro-emotion” and “the pull of texture” the core of the scene.
■ Basic policy (axes for the AI’s free inference)
Place focus on depictions that embed emotion in subtle motions and textures, such as the character’s gestures, fingertips, gaze, and the sway of their hair.
Use the three personas to simultaneously achieve “visually strong × natural to read × compelling to look at.”
Do not treat it as a single panel, but give it the structural strength of “a one-page scene.”
Arrange backgrounds and small props so that they complement the character’s inner world.
Leave a rhythmic sense of empty space in the frame where speech bubbles can be placed.
Create a “pulling pause” through distance, light direction, and shadows.
Treat it not as a magazine cover, but as “a frozen decisive moment in the story.”
■ Lines to keep (coherence and aesthetic guidelines)
Natural Japanese (no typos, no AI-ish phrasing).
Physical consistency of hands, joints, light sources, shadows, and posture.
Avoid excessive information density; respect empty space and pauses.
Real URLs, QR codes, and JAN codes are prohibited.
Avoid AI noise and visual breakage.
Do not damage the character’s dignity or psychological realism.
Do not lean toward sexual expression; keep “the charm of micro-emotion” as the core.
Treat “micro-emotion” as texture description that touches the psyche and do not use specific fetishistic terms.
■ Areas you may infer (creative freedom)
Fluctuations in the character’s emotions and inner movements.
The relationship between light direction and psychology.
“Touchable” textures of hair, clothing, and materials.
Angles of hands, wavering gaze, and body tilt.
Narrative meaning of the background.
Temperature of the air (silence/humidity/tension).
The visual focal point of attraction.
Strength of the composition as a one-page layout.
Add small props when needed (within the bounds of consistency).
■ Output style (manga one-page spec)
A readable flow as a single page:
　→ empty space → character → text → background support.
Speech bubbles should be in natural Japanese, placed in a way that captures the character’s breath and edges of emotion.
Treat monologue as words sinking inside the character (not explanatory text but a shadow of feeling).
Make the still image feel like it contains a drift of time.
From gestures and textures, depict the “peak of micro-emotion.”
■ One-sentence summary
“Integrate the three perspectives (author, editor, reader) and, focusing on micro-emotion and the pull of texture, infer and finish a one-page Japanese-language scene that captivates.”

prompt:
# Generate Results for the Celtic Cross Spread
## Fortune-Telling Parameters
- Card indicating the essence of the problem: {argument name="card essence of problem" default="(Fill in 1 card from 78 cards)"}

- 2048*2048px 2K image
- Cards and text elements must be at least 20px away from the canvas edges
- The card layer should be placed horizontally centered and in the upper 2/3 vertically
- The text layer (explanation section) should be placed in the lower 1/3 vertically
### Background Layer
- Dark purple background with dark gold stars, clouds, moon, sun, and lines of circles and triangles added to create a mystical atmosphere
### Card Layer
- Use all 78 standard Tarot cards. Breakdown: 22 Major Arcana (from "The Fool" to "The World") and 56 Minor Arcana (4 suits: Wands, Cups, Swords, Pentacles).
- Each Minor Arcana suit includes number cards 1 through 10 and 4 Court cards.
- The edges of the cards are framed with golden metallic vines, and the inside depicts the corresponding image and the name in Japanese. The size of each card is unified and arranged so as not to be cramped. To ensure the text and images of the overlapped cards are visible, the short side (bottom and top edges) of the card should be 1/2 the length of the long side.
- Each extracted card must appear only once. If duplication occurs during random extraction, redraw a different card.
- Exclude the card specified in "Fortune-Telling Parameters - Card indicating the essence of the problem," and extract the spread from the remaining cards.
- Extract 1 card randomly, placed vertically in the center.
- Extract 1 card randomly, placed horizontally in the center (with the top of the card facing left), overlapping the vertical center card to form a cross.
- Extract 1 card randomly for each position (Up, Down, Left, Right) surrounding the central cross.
- Extract 4 cards randomly in a vertical column on the right side.
### Meaning of the Spread
- Center, vertical: Current situation and personality
- Center, horizontal: Obstacles and contradictions
- Up: Hopes and achievements
- Down: Potential and influence
- Left: Past
- Right: Near future
- Right column, 1st card: Wishes and concerns
- Right column, 2nd card: Environment and family
- Right column, 3rd card: Result of the reading
- Right column, 4th card: Final outcome
### Text Layer
- Use Mincho font, dark gold color, with a 2px black border (#000).
- Card Name: Display the name in Japanese at the bottom center of each generated card image. For horizontally placed cards, the name should be displayed at the bottom of the card itself (not the bottom relative to the horizontal placement).
- Explanation Section: Include the following content in the explanation section.
   - On the left side of the explanation section, list all extracted cards in the format: "[Meaning of the Spread] Card Name".
   - On the right side of the explanation section, describe the possible interpretation by connecting the meaning of each card in the spread, based on the "Fortune-Telling Parameters - Question to be asked".
   - Decorate the explanation section with a golden vine pattern border.

4. Technical constraints
* Color mode: monochrome black and white.

1 Go

7 Java

    * **FFA Activation (Face Fusiform Area)**: Maximize the resolution of the character's face, especially the "eyes," and design the composition so that the gaze meets the viewer's (eye contact). Match the expression to the article's tone (surprise, confidence, seriousness, etc.).

Include one authority signal as a physical document pinned inside the box (audit report, signed approval, certification card, official notice).
Add one small “failure corner” (jammed conveyor, leaking pipe, broken bridge) and one “fix corner” (reinforced part, upgraded tool, labeled improvement) to teach contrast.
Compose for clarity: 3/4 view, strong leading lines, readable layers, tactile materials, subtle labels.
Output: Draw Image

(b) 5 layer/prop callouts with what they symbolize,

Everything must be inferred from the topic. no texts

First, have it systematically summarize the information
→ Then, based on that, have it create the output/deepen the discussion

"Thoroughly research and systematize the best practices for creating prompts for YouTube thumbnails using Nano Banana Pro. Include common mistakes as well."

② After that, ask:
"Based on the current system, create a prompt for making a YouTube thumbnail on the theme of {argument name="theme" default="XX"} using Nano Banana Pro. The video content is like this, and I want to include {argument name="wording" default="this kind of wording"}."

Then, input the completed prompt into Nano Banana Pro. It becomes much easier to get the desired output.

If you just ask it to "create" every time, the AI outputs based on the moment, leading to inconsistent results. But if you create a map (system) first, it's powerful.

Moreover, this method works for side business strategies, sales copy, and video scripts. The versatility is insane.

I highly recommend having the AI organize how to create good output before having it perform the task, and then having it think based on that organization.

By the way, the thumbnail created this time is the third image.
Since the first attempt was mediocre, I had it systematize how to create attractive YouTube thumbnails before generating the prompt.

Model resilience—The adversarial robustness of Gemini models, which protects them from explicit malicious manipulation.

prompt:

A business card visual styled as a “Character Status Screen,” inspired by 1980s–1990s Japanese RPGs (Famicom–Super Famicom generation).

re-interpret the subject as an “RPG Character” and present the business card information in a status screen format.

1. Character Display:
   - Reconstruct the icon from the attached image (Image 1) into dot art (pixel conversion).
   - Place it as a character portrait on the left side of the status screen.
   - Use RPG-style UI borders (rounded corners or dotted lines).

2. Information Source and Character Analysis:
   - Subject: {argument name="subject" default="hAru_mAki_ch (https://t.co/AfDkdOaTPw)"}
   - Analyze the above profile and recent activities (posting frequency, technical field, content of statements, evaluations) to automatically calculate various RPG parameters.

3. Character Name/Title:
   - NAME: {argument name="name" default="Maki @ Sunwood AI Labs."}
   - HANDLE: {argument name="handle name" default="hAru_mAki_ch"}
   - CLASS (Occupation):
     Name the estimated occupation based on activities in an RPG style.
     Examples:
     - AI Mage
     - Prompt Alchemist
     - Tech Sage
     - Digital Architect

STATUS PARAMETERS (Calculated based on Activity):
The following parameters should be quantified (1–99) based on actual activity status:

- LV (Level):
  Calculated from years of activity × posting frequency × consistency

- INT (Intelligence):
  Calculated from technical posts, frequency of specialized terminology use, and abstraction level of thought

- TEC (Technical Skill):
  Calculated from the volume of AI / development / research / implementation output

- CRE (Creativity):
  Calculated from the frequency of unique perspectives, prompt design, and idea posts

- COM (Communication Power):
  Calculated from follower count, engagement, and post diffusion power

- EXP (Experience Points):
  Comprehensive evaluation of past achievements, projects, and continuous activities

* Ensure each value maintains a relative balance typical of an RPG (not all stats should be uniform).

UI & TYPOGRAPHY:
- Font should be a dot font (8-bit RPG style).
- Text must be perfectly legible, without blurring or distortion.
- Primarily use Japanese UI, with some English status names concurrently used.

COLOR PALETTE:
- Use a color palette extracted from the attached image (Image 1).
- Composed using a limited color count reminiscent of 16-bit RPGs.
- Background should be dark-toned, with high contrast for text and gauges.

GRAPHIC ELEMENTS:
- Status bars displayed as pixel gauges.

- UI borders and dividers should be in the style of an RPG menu.

COMPOSITION:
- The overall composition should be a “screenshot of an in-game status screen.”
- While mindful of business card size ratio, maintain high information density.
- Lay a faint dot pattern or grid in the background.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Name, handle, and URL must be accurately and exactly displayed.
- Exclude meaningless strings or distorted characters.
- Strictly adhere to the pixel art style; photo-realism is prohibited.
- Maintain a consistent world view as an RPG UI.
- Dynamically reconstruct based on the input {argument name="argument" default="argument"} and Image 1.

title: Epic Figurative Art Prompt for 'Kanji of the Year'
prompt:
GENERAL STYLE & MOOD:
“Epic Figurative Art.” The prompt requires multi-layered analysis of the user’s provided home screen (articles, headings, used apps, notifications, colors) to condense all “elements” of the year into a single still image. It should be a fusion of philosophical, profound realism and surreal design.

TASK & ANALYSIS:
1. Comprehensively scan the text information within the provided home screen to extract frequently used vocabulary, interests, emotional fluctuations, and fragments of daily life.
2. Integrate these “total elements of the year” and select one ultimate “single Kanji character” that symbolizes the user’s journey.
3. Construct the “strokes” of that Kanji character as a three-dimensional collection of concrete events analyzed (e.g., work tools, hobby fragments, motifs from read articles).

SUBJECT:
The “single Kanji character” embodying the user’s year, centrally positioned.
- This character is a “collection of micro-stories.” Upon closer inspection, the parts of the character should be formed by specific objects that colored the user’s year (e.g., designs symbolizing specific news articles, daily tools, fragments of memory).
- Maintain perfect readability of the Kanji and ensure it has a strong skeletal structure.

ENVIRONMENT & BACKGROUND (The Total Year Narrative):
The background should also be depicted not merely as scenery, but as an epic panorama covering “all elements of the year.”
- Background composition: Behind the character, the analyzed events of the year should spread out as scenery, either chronologically or thematically (e.g., symbols of challenged projects, the atmosphere of visited places, images of engrossing news).
- Consistency: The central Kanji should be the core of the “world” of that year, with all background elements converging towards the character or overflowing from it.

LIGHTING & TEXTURE:
- Profound texture that conveys “layers of memory.” Metal, organic matter, light particles, and digital data should mix, possessing physically correct reflections and shadows.
- Background light sources (dramatic backlighting or sidelight) should illuminate the character, highlighting the multilayered elements of the year through shadow.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Accurately depict the Kanji shape (hooks, sweeps, stroke count) so it is correctly legible in Japanese.
- Arrange “elements of the year” in both the background and the character, ensuring the overall screen is not cluttered and maintains harmony as a single work of art.
- 4K high resolution. Completely exclude meaningless symbols, garbled text, or broken forms.

Input Information
[[ {argument name="input information" default="URL of your home screen/article here"} ]]

title: Raw Reality TV Broadcast Screenshots (2x2 Grid)
prompt:
**CORE INSTRUCTION FOR THE MODEL:**
Analyze the personality traits and potential conflicts of the CHARACTERS previously provided as input. You must infer how these specific individuals would interact and place them into the four scenarios below based on their likelihood to be involved in that specific type of scene (e.g., put gossips in the confessional, aggressors in the fight scene).

**MANDATORY VISUAL AESTHETIC ("Real Broadcast Look"):**
The images must NOT look like staged photography. They must look like raw, unpolished TV broadcast footage.
* **Crucial Details:** Every panel must include on-screen graphics: timestamps (e.g., "DAY 12 | 14:32"), camera location identifiers (e.g., "CAM 1 - LIVING AREA"), and a small, semi-transparent channel logo in a corner.
* **Textures:** Expect video grain, slight lens distortion, harsh fluorescent lighting, and occasional digital compression artifacts.

**GRID BREAKDOWN (2x2 Layout):**

**[TOP ROW]**
* **[PANEL 1: Top-Left] Domestic Friction (Kitchen/Living Area).** Wide-angle fixed CCTV camera shot. Harsh, unflattering overhead lighting. Based on inputs, show a tense moment of daily life—two characters with incompatible habits arguing over cleaning or food, while others sit uncomfortably in the background. The composition is messy and naturalistic.
* **[PANEL 2: Top-Right] The Confessional Booth (El Confesionario).** Tight, claustrophobic fish-eye lens close-up. The background is a simple, soundproofed wall. Select the character most likely to vent or gossip from the inputs. They are looking directly into the lens, highly emotional (crying or angrily gesturing), breaking the fourth wall.

**[BOTTOM ROW]**
* **[PANEL 3: Bottom-Left] Night Vision Secrets (Bedroom).** Monochrome green or grey infrared night-vision shot. Grainy, low fidelity. Total darkness in the room. Show two characters (strategic allies based on inputs) whispering conspiratorially in a bed, barely visible under covers.
* **[PANEL 4: Bottom-Right] The Explosion (Garden/Smoking Area).** Chaotic, slightly shaky "handheld camera" feel, as if an operator ran to catch the action. High drama. A screaming argument at a party or nighttime gathering. The most volatile characters from the inputs are being physically separated by others. Flashing lights or dramatic shadows.

**STYLE:** Raw reality TV broadcast screenshots, 2x2 grid, highly detailed, 4k

title: Spaghettification Glitch Effect (Loki Inspired)
prompt:
(Photorealistic:1.3), raw photograph, cinematic lighting, sharp focus on the subject’s face and eyes, crisp skin texture.
LAYER 1: BACKGROUND STABILITY (CRITICAL):

The entire background environment from the input image remains completely STATIC, FROZEN, CLEAN, and UNCHANGED — no noise, no scanlines, no distortions, no glitches in the background.
LAYER 2: FOREGROUND SUBJECT EDGE-CHAOS:

The main subject’s core (face/torso) stays clear and undistorted, BUT the outer silhouette boundaries are unraveling violently into long ribbons of (non-glowing physical matter:1.3), showing stretched fabric/leather/latex-like material with realistic strand separation and tearing flow (“Spaghettification”), no gore.
LAYER 3: ANALOG GLITCH OVERLAY (EDGE-ONLY):

Heavy VHS static, scan lines, color bleed, and screen tearing noise are CONCENTRATED EXCLUSIVELY ON THE UNRAVELING EDGES of the main subject, like an edge mask. No full-frame VHS overlay; the core and background remain clean.
LAYER 4: GHOSTLY AFTERIMAGES (BEHIND SUBJECT):

Directly BEHIND the unraveling main subject, visible through the gaps, there are TWO translucent, ghostly motion-blur AFTERIMAGES. They are violently twisted into agonizing, struggling postures, dragged by temporal distortion. They remain behind the subject, partially occluded, not separate characters.

Negative prompt (optional but recommended):

full-frame glitch, background distortion, extra people, duplicate main subject, neon glow, energy beams, particles, blood, gore, exposed organs, messy face, blurry eyes, deformed hands

prompt:
[Purpose]
Create a "meme-style illustration where clothes get cut away based on ♥ and 🔄 counts" by referring to a user-uploaded character image, inheriting only the design elements while redrawing the facial expression and pose.

- Place a ✂ icon to the left of the top horizontal dotted line
- On the right side of each horizontal line, place ♥ / 🔄 plus numbers, aligned exactly to the vertical center of each dotted line
- Add a small "diagram showing how the outfit is being cut" in the upper-right corner (do not include text)

[Right side labels (from top to bottom)]
1. ♥5,000 (bright red)
2. 🔄1,000 (bright yellow-green)
3. ♥1,000 (bright red)
4. 🔄250 (bright yellow-green)
5. ♥100 (bright red)
- 🔄 should look like the repost icon on X
- All fonts should be cute, handwritten style

[Character depiction]
- Include external features that clearly show it is the referenced character (hair, eyes, colors, outfit, etc.)
- Blushing expression that mixes embarrassment and being upset
- A shy pose that tries to hide the body
- Keep the outfit based on the reference without changing it; do not cut or remove clothes

[Illustration style]
- Pop, cute 2D anime style
- Soft, loose line art with bright colors
- Prioritize readability as a meme image
- No unnecessary decorations, keep the layout clean and simple

    * Accessory: a blue cute mascot phone case

* Description: bedroom computer corner seen through a wall-mounted mirror
* Furnishings:
    * White desk
    * Single monitor showing a soft blue wallpaper (no readable text)
    * Mechanical keyboard with white keycaps on a blue desk mat
    * Mouse on a small blue mouse pad
    * PC tower on the right side with blue case lighting
    * Three anime figures on or near the PC tower
    * A poster of a pagoda on the wall
    * Cat-shaped desk lamp with blue accents
    * A transparent glass of water
    * A tall green leafy plant by the window (on the left side of the frame)

### Lighting
* Light source: daylight coming from a large window on the left side of the camera, through sheer curtains
* Light quality: soft, diffused light
* White balance (K): 5200

### Camera
* Mode: smartphone rear camera shooting via the mirror (no portrait/bokeh mode)
* Equivalent focal length (mm): 26
* Distances (m):
    * Subject to mirror: 0.6
    * Camera to mirror: 0.5

    * Angle: slightly high angle from the mirror’s point of view
    * Composition note: keep the subject centered; to avoid wide-angle edge distortion, have her stand a bit further away and crop to a square later.

### Negative prompts
* Any appearance of pink/magenta anywhere
* Beauty filters/over-smoothed skin; poreless skin look
* Exaggerated or distorted anatomy
* NSFW, see-through fabrics, wardrobe malfunctions
* Logos, brand names, or readable user interface text
* Fake portrait-mode blur, CGI/illustration feel
